title: partner-cloud-marketplace-weekly-prep-jamie-2026-03-09
content:
Weekly partner/cloud marketplace sync — prep notes and follow-ups

Meeting details:
- Date: 2026-03-09
- Time: 10:00am PT (30m)
- Format: quick status + blockers + asks
- Attendees (expected): Alex Rivera (AWS PM), Priya Patel (Azure Alliances), Samir Shah (GCP BD), Marta K. (Channel), Jamie Chen (Redwood lead)

Primary goals for this week:
1) Quick health-check across AWS/Azure/GCP listings (approval status, listing live dates)
2) Confirm billing & contract ask status for Dedicated offerings in marketplace flows
3) Surface mobile/edge packaging ask from GCP partner pilot
4) Align on next steps for co-marketing timelines + NAC approvals

Agenda (rough):
- 0–3m: quick wins and numbers (Jamie)
- 3–12m: AWS marketplace status (Alex) — contract signoffs, test purchases, billing mapping
- 12–20m: Azure/GCP updates (Priya / Samir) — listing reviews, security checklist outstanding items
- 20–26m: Channel partner updates + co-marketing timeline (Marta)
- 26–30m: Action items, owners, due dates (Jamie)

Key data points to call out (prep):
- AWS: sandbox listing passed basic QA last week; still waiting on legal for fee structure (see JIRA PRJ-2145). Test purchase flow succeeded 2/3 times — need to repro intermittent tokenization error.
- Azure: marketplace draft approved by platform, pending listing copy + screenshots. Need confirmation on meter-reporting format for usage-based pricing.
- GCP: pilot (edge inference packaging) proof-of-concept completed; partner requested smaller container (quantized) + docs for private deploys.
- Conversions: trial->paid conversion low for marketplace flows (approx 2.1% last month) — hypothesize friction in onboarding / marketplace billing mapping.

Talking points / notes to surface:
- For AWS: request explicit timeline from Alex on legal approvals + who on their side can accelerate fee review. Offer to provide a short one-pager that maps Redwood Dedicated contract terms to AWS marketplace terms (I can draft today).
- For Azure: need clarity on meter-reporting schema — ask Priya for sample telemetry mapping; propose weekly sync between our billing eng & Azure meter team to avoid rework.
- For GCP: ensure we get partner ask in writing for smaller container images; engineering note: quantized images might need a different compatibility test matrix (seq length / KV cache). Raise with infra team if pilot expands.
- Co-marketing: Marta — confirm 2 week lead time for joint PR and webinar assets. Ask for templated quote + logos this week.

Open questions / unresolved
- Who on AWS legal is the point for fee mapping? (Alex to confirm)
- Is there appetite to run a joint trial program for Dedicated (with committed capacity) vs marketplace listing? (use case for mid-market customers)
- Billing: can marketplace metering be reconciled 1:1 with our internal tokens/units? If not, what's the delta mapping? (billing eng deep dive needed)

Risks / blockers
- Legal / fee approval delays block go-live on AWS listing (impact: launch slip of 2–4 weeks)
- Metering format mismatches cause accounting reconciliation work and delayed payouts
- Engineering: packaging size/perf for GCP edge pilot could increase infra QA time

Proposed asks (what we need from partners this week)
- AWS: confirm named legal reviewer + ETA on fee decision; provide any additional compliance checklist items.
- Azure: sample meter-report payload; confirm screenshot/marketing copy owner and deadline.
- GCP: formalize container size/format requirements; sign off on pilot metrics (latency, mem, cost).
- Channel partners: sign off on co-marketing timeline + provide logos/quotes by 03/16.

Follow-ups & action items (owner — due)
- Action: Draft one-pager mapping Redwood Dedicated terms -> AWS marketplace terms — Owner: Jamie Chen — Due: 2026-03-10 — Status: todo
- Action: Alex to confirm AWS legal point-of-contact + ETA for fee decision — Owner: Alex Rivera — Due: 2026-03-11 — Status: todo
- Action: Priya to share Azure meter-report example & confirm telemetry contacts — Owner: Priya Patel — Due: 2026-03-12 — Status: todo
- Action: Samir to provide formal container requirements for GCP pilot (size targets + quantization constraints) — Owner: Samir Shah — Due: 2026-03-13 — Status: todo
- Action: Marta to share co-marketing checklist and draft timeline for PR/webinar — Owner: Marta Kowalski — Due: 2026-03-16 — Status: todo
- Action: Billing eng (TBD) to run mapping workshop for marketplace metering vs internal tokens — Owner: billing-eng (need assignee) — Due: 2026-03-17 — Status: blocked (awaiting partner samples)

Prep checklist for the call (what I need to pull together before meeting):
- Quick slide: one-pager for AWS mapping (Jamie) — draft today
- Slack thread summary in #partners-marketplace with ask list (Jamie) — post after meeting
- Share Confluence page CONF-4521 with partners (link in linked_artifacts) and ensure comments section is enabled
- Attach demo video of test purchase flow for AWS (upload to drive + share link)

Notes to self (scratchpad):
- Keep call tight — push deeper technical billing discussions to smaller breakout w/ billing eng + partner meter team.
- If AWS legal stalls >1 week, propose temporary workaround: soft-launch in selected regions with limited beta customers (need ops signoff).
- Track conversion metric changes week-over-week post-launch; set baseline and plan A/B for onboarding flow in marketplace listing.

Post-meeting follow-up template (use this to email attendees):
- Quick thanks + TL;DR of decisions (1–2 bullets)
- Action items (owner + due date) copied from above
- Links: Confluence page, JIRA tickets, demo artifacts, Slack thread
- Ask for confirmation of who owns each pending item on partner side

References / links to keep handy:
- CONF-4521 (marketplace onboarding notes + checklist)
- JIRA PRJ-2145 (AWS fee mapping / contract draft)
- Github PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-proposals/pull/42 (listing metadata schema)
- Slack: #partners-marketplace (thread-xy123)

End of prep notes.

(quick TODO after meeting: update Confluence page with outcomes + tag billing eng + create follow-up calendar invites for breakout sessions)
